_readme: Editable source of truth for BC freshwater fishing-regulation POINT CURATION. One entry per distinct (regulation, locator string), grouped by the split anchor kind it maps to in stream_sections/splits.json. To curate a row: fill `target` and/or `coord`/`split_id`, optionally set `label`, move any research into `notes`, then set `status` to "curated". Converted 1:1 from 17-locators-to-curate.md; see that file for the how-to.

_schema.id: stable unique slug (kebab of name + short content hash)
_schema.name_verbatim: regulation title exactly as it appears in the md (may be truncated)
_schema.src: where the locator came from: name | entry | rule | except
_schema.locator_text: the locator string to resolve to a point/reach (may be truncated in the source md)
_schema.anchor_kind: bucket this locator sits under; see anchor_kinds for what each maps to
_schema.target: resolved feature target: object like {blk:..} / {wsc:..} / {gnis:..}, or '' if unset
_schema.coord: [lon, lat] once a single point is chosen, else null
_schema.split_id: id of the split authored in splits.json, or ''
_schema.label: short human label for the point/section, or ''
_schema.notes: free text; carries any human research/annotation verbatim
